text: Buying a home in Victoria? Here's a quick guide from Elderfield Conveyancing. Before a property is sold, the seller must give you a Section 32 statement, with details like mortgages, easements and zoning. Have it checked by your own lawyer or conveyancer before you buy. The property is sold when both you and the seller sign the contract. For a private sale of a home, you then have three clear business days to cool off, but not at auction. Settlement is usually thirty to ninety days later, when the balance is paid and the title documents are exchanged. Buying a home? Our team can help. Speak with Elderfield Conveyancing.
